    Class
    Description
    CreateOidcProviderRequest
    Request body for registering a new OIDC provider via POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/oidcProviders (operationId createOidcProvider, spec schema CreateOidcProviderBody).
    ListPoliciesGrantedRequest
    Request body for POST /v1/accessPoliciesGranted (operationId listAccessPoliciesGranted, spec schema ListPoliciesGrantedInput) — lists the access policies granted to the subject identified by a token within a project.
    PatchOidcProviderRequest
    Request body for modifying an existing OIDC provider via PATCH /v1/projects/{projectId}/oidcProviders/{idpId} (operationId patchOidcProvider, spec schema PatchOidcProviderBody).
    TokenRequest
    An OAuth 2.0 token-exchange request body (RFC 8693) for POST /v1/token (operationId generateStsToken, spec schema TokenRequest).
